# Shree Dhootapapeshwar Limited (SDL India)
> Authentic, standardized, and safe Ayurvedic healthcare formulations and classical medicines manufactured since 1872.

## Core Corporate Information
- [Company Profile](https://www.sdlindia.com/about-us/company-profile): The legacy, values, and 150+ year commitment of the Puranik family to Saiddhantik Ayurved.
- [Shree Dhootapapeshwar Standards (SDS)](https://www.sdlindia.com/about-us/sdl-legacy): Quality parameters, identity mapping, and consistency evaluations for Ayurvedic formulations.

## Product Catalog & Collections
- [Ayurvedic Product Collections](https://www.sdlindia.com/collections): Complete overview of classical formulations including Suvarnakalpa, Guggulu, Parpati, Pottali, Bhasma, Asava-arishta, and Guti-Vati.
- [Online Shopping Portal](https://www.sdlindia.com/): Browse, review, and purchase authentic wellness and Ayurvedic formulations online.

## Resources & Events
- [Ayurveda Events & Lectures](https://www.sdlindia.com/events/late-vaidyaraj-shrimant-nanasaheb-puranik-memorial-lecture-21st-august-2026): Academic updates, webcasts, and memory lectures charting historical and modern advancements in Ayurvedic science.
- [SDL Access App](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.sdlindia.app): Platform details for the mobile companion app featuring health blogs, expert videos, and shopping logs for consumers and Vaidyas.

## Compliance & Legal
- [Terms & Conditions](https://www.sdlindia.com/terms-and-conditions): E-commerce rules, product availability terms, and prescription requirements for specific Rasaushadhis.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.sdlindia.com/privacy-policy): Data handling policies and user privacy guardrails across online services.
